label: Manifesto de Marca (60s) · A Cidade Viva (Arquitetura Bioclimática & Futuro)
description: Manifesto de urbanismo e arquitetura sustentável em 16:9: arranha-céus em madeira engenheirada (mass timber), fachadas cinéticas respiráveis, praças públicas arborizadas e mobilidade elétrica fluida.

scenes.prompt: Visionary architectural brand manifesto cinematography in 16:9. A soaring 40-story mass timber and glass skyscraper surrounded by lush cascading green balconies under bright morning sun. The warm natural grain of structural cross-laminated timber beams is visible through panoramic glass. 24mm tilt-shift cinema lens. Non-verbal sound design: gentle morning breeze rustling terrace trees, soft city hum. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: A CIDADE QUE RESPIRA.

Visionary architectural brand manifesto cinematography in 16:9. Close-up on a smart biomimetic kinetic facade: thousands of hexagonal natural wood louvers gently adjust their angles in synchronized fluid motion to follow the solar trajectory, optimizing shade and natural airflow. Non-verbal sound design: whisper-quiet mechanical servo glides and soft acoustic wood clicking. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: ARQUITETURA INTELIGENTE.

Visionary architectural brand manifesto cinematography in 16:9. Pedestrian-level wide shot of an urban boulevard with zero cars: lush rain gardens, water fountains where children play, citizens cycling on wide permeable terracotta paths, solar electric trams gliding silently. Warm, vibrant community life. Non-verbal sound design: joyful distant laughter, water fountain splash, quiet tram chime. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: ESPAÇO PARA AS PESSOAS.

Visionary architectural brand manifesto cinematography in 16:9. An interior open-air rooftop community farm at sunset. Residents harvest organic vegetables and herbs against the backdrop of an illuminated skyline of green roof gardens under a pastel indigo twilight sky. Non-verbal sound design: fresh herb snapping sound, warm acoustic cello chords. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: RECONEXÃO COM A TERRA.

Visionary architectural brand manifesto cinematography in 16:9. Sweeping cinematic aerial view at dusk: the entire bioclimatic district lights up with warm amber 2700K low-glare architectural lighting, glowing like an organic living forest canopy in the evening. Non-verbal sound design: soaring French horns and driving orchestral percussion. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: O NOVO URBANISMO.

Visionary architectural brand manifesto cinematography in 16:9. Hero brand lockup: clean modern architectural typography and brand signature appear centered over the harmonious horizon where city lights blend seamlessly with natural green topography under starlight. Non-verbal sound design: triumphant grand orchestral finale resolving into peaceful room tone. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: A CIDADE DO AMANHÃ.

narration.text: Durante um século, as cidades foram pensadas para o concreto e o tráfego. O futuro do urbanismo é devolver o espaço às pessoas, integrando a inteligência dos materiais à vitalidade da natureza.
narration.voice: voz masculina brasileira madura, visionária, calorosa, confiante e inspiradora, estilo manifesto global de urbanismo sustentável

blocks.text: As cidades do futuro não serão feitas de cinza e isolamento.
Edifícios vivos que respiram e se adaptam à luz do sol.
Ruas devolvidas aos passos, às árvores e aos encontros.
Onde cada bairro produz sua própria energia e alimento.
A tecnologia e a ecologia unidas pelo bem-estar comum.
A cidade viva. O amanhã começa onde você pisa.

audio.musicIntent: Visionary and uplifting orchestral score with bright brass, warm strings, sparkling mallets, driving percussion and a triumphant modern resolution.
